units.translation: ⟦1⟧' Hermann, cf. ⟦2⟧ 994; then ⟦3⟧ quite easily Ahrens, which is better than ⟦4⟧ (Hermann after Canter), where the infinitive instead of the participle is not justifiable, and also than ⟦5⟧ (Stanley), which is too far from the features. "And indeed we believe (with litotes) that we are very just in the distribution." In 313 the transmitted ⟦6⟧.. ⟦7⟧ throws the rhythms into confusion, unless one inserts with Hermann: ⟦8⟧ | <⟦9⟧> ⟦10⟧, or inserts in some other way; that then the singular ⟦11⟧ follows is no different than in the stasimon antistrophe ⟦12⟧. Perhaps, however, as the same Hermann earlier: ⟦13⟧, not difficult and smoother; Paley compares the corruption ⟦14⟧ ⟦15⟧ instead of (as the verse requires) ⟦16⟧. ⟦17⟧.
